# MDViewer — full agent brief

> Protocol 3 share API + MCP on the Worker. SPA and Worker both serve `/llms.txt` / `/llms-full.txt` (SPA files are the source of truth; Worker embeds a generated copy).

## Product

- SPA: `apps/web` — local files/projects in browser storage, GFM + Mermaid + KaTeX preview
- Worker: `apps/worker` — share upload/download on R2, fair-use, fixed TTL, manage token + optional view password
- Config: public Vite defaults (`VITE_API_URL`, `VITE_FRONTEND_URL`) or Settings → Share override (http/https only). Operator caps: `apps/worker/src/lib/config.ts` (self-host edit + redeploy); SPA reads `/compatibility`.

## Auth (never conflate)

| Capability | Mechanism | Who |
|------------|-----------|-----|
| View link | Share id in URL | Anyone with the link |
| View-protect | Optional disposable **view password** → `X-Share-Password` on GET | Readers the creator trusts |
| Manage | **Manage token** → `Authorization: Bearer` (preferred) or `X-Share-Manage-Token` | Creator device / SPA Settings `#token` / MCP client |

Mutate/delete/upload/rotate **never** accept the view password as admin.

## Public Worker API (protocol 3)

Base: `https://api.mdviewer.zamdev.dev` (or self-hosted worker)

| Method | Path | Notes |
|--------|------|-------|
| GET | `/health` | `{ ok: true }` |
| GET | `/compatibility` | Handshake (`protocol: 3`); features + `ttl` + `limits` |
| POST | `/upload` | Create; **manage token required**; optional view password + TTL headers |
| GET | `/share/:id` | Raw markdown; view password if `viewProtected` |
| GET | `/share/:id/meta` | Anon metadata (no hashes) |
| PUT | `/share/:id` | Replace content; **manage token**; keeps `expiresAt` |
| PATCH | `/share/:id` | `{ viewProtected, viewPassword? }`; **manage token** |
| DELETE | `/share/:id` | Wipe prefix; **manage token** |
| POST | `/share/rotate-manage` | Bulk re-key `manageTokenHash`; Bearer **old** token; body `shareIds` + `newManageToken`; cap from `limits.rotateManageMaxIds` (default 50) |
| POST | `/mcp` | MCP JSON-RPC (`initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`) |
| GET | `/mcp` | Discovery JSON |
| GET | `/llms.txt` | Agent brief |
| GET | `/llms-full.txt` | This file |
| GET | `/docs` | Swagger UI |
| GET | `/openapi.json` | OpenAPI document |

CORS / constructed frontend share URLs use worker `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (see `apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc`). Allow `Authorization` and `X-Share-Manage-Token`.

Upload / manage headers: `Authorization: Bearer <manageToken>` or `X-Share-Manage-Token`; optional view `X-Share-Password` when protect on; `X-Share-TTL-Seconds` (default 7d, max 30d); `X-Share-View-Protected`; `X-Share-Filename`; `X-Share-Type`.

## MCP tools

`get_share`, `get_share_meta`, `upload_share`, `update_share`, `delete_share`

- `upload_share` / `update_share` / `delete_share` require **`manageToken`**
- `get_share` uses **`viewPassword`** only when `viewProtected` (alias `password` deprecated)
- Fair-use is stricter for MCP (`X-MDViewer-Client: mcp`)

## Share URLs (same path shape everywhere)

| Surface | URL | Returns |
|---------|-----|---------|
| SPA viewer | `https://mdviewer.zamdev.dev/share/<id>` | Rendered markdown UI |
| Worker raw | `https://api.mdviewer.zamdev.dev/share/<id>` | Plain markdown (`text/plain`) |
| Worker meta | `https://api.mdviewer.zamdev.dev/share/<id>/meta` | JSON metadata |

MCP `upload_share` returns `frontendShareUrl` (SPA) and `contentUrl` (Worker raw). Both are `/share/<id>` (no trailing slash). App routes (`/editor`, `/settings`, …) also use no trailing slash.

Share viewer exposes metadata via `GET /share/:id/meta` (Details control in the SPA).

In-doc fragment links (`#heading`) work in editor preview and share viewer (first matching heading wins).

## Still open (pre-v4.0)

- Large-doc performance (virtual scroll / lazy heavy blocks) — `maintainer/phases/04-perf-large-docs.md`
- Nested projects / CSP nonce / ModalShell leftovers — `maintainer/final.md` §7
- Wipe Worker R2 before real v4 deploy (protocol 3-only objects)

Track release readiness in `maintainer/final.md`. Do **not** bump to v4.0 until that checklist is cleared and approved. Stay on **3.x.x** until then.

## Security notes

- Preview: rehype-sanitize after KaTeX; Mermaid `securityLevel: "strict"`
- Pages: CSP, X-Frame-Options DENY, COOP
- Manage vs view secrets: https://github.com/zamdevio/mdviewer/blob/main/docs/security.md
